description: Classical MAB with rewards that follow no single family: 10 instances with 10 arms, each arm a random mixture of 2 or 3 components (Bernoulli, Beta, uniform, Gaussian clipped to [0, 1]), gap >= 0.05, 2 runs each. Policies built for Bernoulli (KL-UCB, Bernoulli Thompson Sampling) or Gaussian rewards (UCB1-Normal, Gaussian Thompson Sampling) against distribution-free and variance-aware ones. Theoretical defaults.
